links.passage: Drip or sprinkler irrigation uses less water for irrigation as it applies the water drop by drop or sprinkles it like artificial rain, whereas localized irrigation applies water to specific places on the surface, and, in subsurface irrigation, water is applied to the crop’s root zone [25].
